description: The plot illustrates the results of "Whisper fine-tunning, type = tiny" by comparing five different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "epoch" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6 with a tick label interval of 1. The y-axis is labeled "WER" and uses a linear scale ranging from 30 to 70 with a tick label interval of 10. All lines in the plot are dark gray. The "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" configuration is represented by a solid line with circle markers; it starts at an epoch of 0 with a WER of approximately 68.8, steadily declines across the epochs, and ends at an epoch of 6 with a WER of roughly 36.2. The "tiny AdaLoRA_int8" configuration is shown as a solid line with square markers; it begins at x=0, y=59.8, experiences a slight plateau between epochs 1 (y=51.2) and 2 (y=50.8), and then continues to decline, ending at x=6, y=32.0. The "tiny int4" line is dashed with circle markers; it starts at x=0, y=68.8, decreases to x=4, y=39.4, and then slightly increases to end at x=6, y=40.1. The "tiny int8" line is dashed with square markers; it begins at x=0, y=59.8, drops to x=1, y=46.7, and then gradually declines to end at x=6, y=36.9. Finally, the "tiny full" configuration is depicted by a dotted line with triangle markers; it starts at a lower initial value of x=0, y=28.8, and exhibits a very gradual decline, ending at x=6, y=22.9.
